page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.sn1ne family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, featuring 16 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance divergence between single-threaded and multi-threaded operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with the Geekbench single-core score and single-threaded gzip compression falling into the bottom 10% and 25% tiers respectively. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by the multi-threaded stress-ng CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core score. Memory bandwidth benchmarks for both small and large blocks also align with middle-tier performance, though the PassMark memory score is positioned in the lower 25% bracket.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. It is suitable for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, image processing, and moderate database operations, where its dedicated physical cores can be fully utilized. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the use of older Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 hardware offers a functional trade-off, providing dedicated compute resources at a lower cost profile, though it lacks the single-core speed and advanced instruction sets of newer processor generations.
